verdict.rationale: Poly is a SaaS file platform with a CLI and an MCP server, so a separate sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it, but the evidence pack never documents one. The closest material is version history, Flashback rollback and blocking irreversible deletes over MCP. These are adjacent recovery and safety controls that act on the real data, not isolation from it, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
